verdict.rationale: Railway's docs say you can 'develop locally' with the Railway CLI. Nothing in the pack describes a local simulator or emulator that reproduces the production runtime, so this is a related local-development claim rather than the capability the story asks for. Local-to-production runtime parity is a fair axis for a cloud PaaS, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime
